ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious MsiExec Embedding Parent
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries may abuse msiexec.exe to proxy the execution of malicious payloads

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$")) AND (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*MsiExec\\\.exe.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-Embedding\\ .*"))) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\SplunkUniversalForwarder\\\\bin\\\\.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\DismFoDInstall\\\.cmd.*") OR (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\MsiExec\\\.exe\\ \\-Embedding\\ .*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*Global\\\\MSI0000.*"))))
